name: stitchiq
description: STITCHIQ — AI embroidery design platform (monorepo scaffold). TypeScript frontend + Python backend.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n frontend,backend -c blue,green "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev:backend"
scripts.backend:setup: cd apps/backend && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && pip install -r requirements.txt
